```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(icesTAF)
library(FLCore)
library(FLSAM)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(theme_bw())

stockcode <- "hom.27.4bc7d" # repo/stock identifier - not year-dependent, safe to fix

# each model run gets its own figures subfolder, keyed off model_file's name
# (e.g. "benchmark", "obsvarpool", "final") - report.R renders this Rmd once
# per model/*.RData into a shared report/ tree, and without this the runs
# would overwrite each other's same-named PNGs (e.g. stock_summary.png)
run_name <- sub("^model_", "", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(params$model_file)))
FIG_DIR <- file.path("report/figures", run_name)
mkdir("report")
mkdir(FIG_DIR)

# Saves a ggplot (or a base/lattice plot passed as a zero-arg function) to
# FIG_DIR at print resolution, then embeds that exact file in the report -
# this is what keeps "all images in one folder, at good resolution" true
# instead of relying on knitr's per-chunk figure cache.
save_and_show <- function(p, filename, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300) {
  path <- file.path(FIG_DIR, filename)
  if (inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(path, plot = p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  } else {
    png(path, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = dpi, bg = "white")
    on.exit(dev.off())
    p()
  }
  knitr::include_graphics(path)
}

# FLSAM accessors on an FLSAM object return a data.frame with year/value/lbnd/ubnd
# (confidence bounds); on a plain FLStock they return an FLQuant. This helper
# normalises either into a common data.frame shape.
as_series <- function(x, name) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  df <- if (is.data.frame(x)) x else as.data.frame(x)
  names(df) <- tolower(names(df))
  if (!"value" %in% names(df)) {
    if ("data" %in% names(df)) df$value <- df$data
    else if ("estimate" %in% names(df)) df$value <- df$estimate
  }
  if (!"year" %in% names(df) || !"value" %in% names(df)) {
    warning("as_series: unexpected shape for ", name, " - skipping")
    return(NULL)
  }
  df$year <- as.numeric(df$year)
  if (!"lbnd" %in% names(df)) df$lbnd <- NA
  if (!"ubnd" %in% names(df)) df$ubnd <- NA
  df$series <- name
  df[, c("year", "value", "lbnd", "ubnd", "series")]
}
```

```{r lena-parse}
# Generic parser for the repeated "<title> by Area" blocks in the InterCatch
# CatchAndSampleDataTables.txt export. Table length is detected from the file
# itself (first blank/non-tabular line) rather than assumed from a fixed age
# range, and the "All periods" (or a given quarter) sub-table is located by
# matching its preceding "For Period" line rather than a hardcoded position -
# quarterly sub-tables 1-4 followed by the combined "All periods" table is
# the standard InterCatch export order, kept here only as a fallback.
extract_area_table <- function(lines, title, period = "All periods", fallback_occurrence = 5) {
  starts <- grep(title, lines, fixed = TRUE)
  if (length(starts) == 0) return(NULL)
  sel <- starts[vapply(starts, function(i) {
    ctx <- lines[max(1, i - 6):max(1, i - 1)]
    any(grepl(paste0("For Period\\t", period), ctx))
  }, logical(1))]
  start <- if (length(sel) > 0) sel[1] else starts[min(fallback_occurrence, length(starts))]

  header <- strsplit(lines[start + 3], "\t")[[1]]
  body <- character(0)
  j <- start + 4
  while (j <= length(lines) && grepl("\t", lines[j]) && nchar(trimws(lines[j])) > 0) {
    body <- c(body, lines[j])
    j <- j + 1
  }
  if (length(body) == 0) return(NULL)

  rows <- strsplit(body, "\t")
  age  <- vapply(rows, `[`, character(1), 1)
  vals <- lapply(rows, function(r) as.numeric(gsub(",", "", r[-1])))
  df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, vals))
  names(df) <- header[-1]
  df$age <- as.numeric(age)
  df
}

catch_file <- list.files(taf.data.path(), pattern = "CatchAndSampleDataTables", full.names = TRUE)[1]
catch_lines <- scan(catch_file, what = character(), sep = "\n", quiet = TRUE)

pad_ages <- function(df) {
  full <- data.frame(age = minAge:maxAge)
  out  <- left_join(full, df, by = "age")
  out[is.na(out)] <- 0
  out$year <- currentYear
  out
}

lena_area  <- pad_ages(extract_area_table(catch_lines, "Mean Length at Age by Area"))
canum_area <- pad_ages(extract_area_table(catch_lines, "Catch Numbers at Age by Area"))
weca_area  <- pad_ages(extract_area_table(catch_lines, "Mean Weight at Age by Area"))

write.csv(lena_area,  "report/lena_area.csv",  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(canum_area, "report/canum_area.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(weca_area,  "report/weca_area.csv",  row.names = FALSE)

area_cols <- setdiff(names(lena_area), c("age", "year", "Total"))
```

## Catch curves and total mortality by cohort

```{r catch-curves-setup}
# a cohort needs several years of observed ages to fit a reliable slope;
# 8 years mirrors the cutoff used in past editions of this report (which used
# a fixed calendar year), kept here as a relative offset so it scales forward
minCohortSpan  <- 8
startYearCohort <- startYr
endYearCohort   <- endYr - minCohortSpan
stkCohort <- FLCohort(log(NSHOM@catch.n))
```

```{r catch-curves-plot}
save_and_show(
  function() print(FLCore::plot(stkCohort[, as.character(startYearCohort:endYearCohort)])),
  "catch_curves_by_cohort.png"
)
```

```{r catch-curves-slope}
coh  <- startYearCohort:endYearCohort
data_coh <- as.data.frame(stkCohort)

slope_df <- bind_rows(lapply(coh, function(cy) {
  datsel <- data_coh[data_coh$cohort == cy & !is.na(data_coh$data) & data_coh$data > 0, ]
  if (nrow(datsel) < 2) return(NULL)
  fit <- lm(log(data) ~ age, data = datsel)
  data.frame(cohort = cy, Z = -coef(fit)[["age"]])
}))

p_slope <- ggplot(slope_df, aes(cohort, Z)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "Cohort", y = "Total mortality Z",
       title = "Total mortality by cohort (catch curve slope)")

save_and_show(p_slope, "catch_curves_by_cohort_slope.png")
write.csv(drop(stkCohort), "report/catch_at_age_cohort.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## IBTS/CGFS SSB index: standardization comparison

```{r survey-index-compare, results='asis'}
# fixed to the 2025 assessment's re-standardization (2024 data year) - copied directly
# from that repo's boot/data/delta-LN_SSB.rda, not regenerated here. Update this file
# (and its name) when a newer prior-vintage comparison is wanted.
prev_std_file <- taf.data.path("delta-LN_SSB_2024_data_year.rda")

if (file.exists(prev_std_file)) {
  prev_env <- new.env()
  load(prev_std_file, envir = prev_env)
  prev_idx <- data.frame(
    year  = as.numeric(rownames(prev_env$SI.dln_SSB$idx)),
    value = as.numeric(prev_env$SI.dln_SSB$idx[, 1])
  )
  prevYr <- max(prev_idx$year)

  ssb_env <- new.env()
  load(taf.data.path("delta-LN_SSB.Rda"), envir = ssb_env)
  cur_idx <- data.frame(
    year = as.numeric(rownames(ssb_env$SI.dln_SSB$idx)),
    value = as.numeric(ssb_env$SI.dln_SSB$idx[, 1])
  )

  std_labels <- c(paste0("Standardized through ", prevYr, " (2024 data year, 2025 assessment)"),
                  paste("Standardized through", endYr))

  std_df <- bind_rows(
    prev_idx %>% mutate(standardization = std_labels[1]),
    cur_idx  %>% mutate(standardization = std_labels[2])
  )
  std_df$standardization <- factor(std_df$standardization, levels = std_labels)

  std_pal <- setNames(c("#8a94a6", "#1f6feb"), std_labels)

  pct_diff_df <- inner_join(prev_idx, cur_idx, by = "year", suffix = c("_prev", "_cur")) %>%
    mutate(pct_diff = round((value_cur - value_prev) / value_prev * 100, 2))

  p_std_top <- ggplot(std_df, aes(year, value, colour = standardization)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = std_pal) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "SSB index\n(log scale)", colour = NULL,
         title = "IBTS Q3 + CGFS Q4 SSB index: standardization comparison") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

  p_std_bot <- ggplot(pct_diff_df, aes(year, pct_diff)) +
    geom_col(fill = std_pal[[2]], width = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
    labs(x = "Year", y = paste0("% change\nvs ", prevYr, " fit")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12)

  p_std <- p_std_top / p_std_bot + plot_layout(heights = c(2.2, 1))
  save_and_show(p_std, "ssb_index_standardization_comparison.png", height = 7.5)
}
```

## Commercial catch overview

```{r catch-tables}
table_marks <- grep("^TABLE", catch_lines)

parse_table_block <- function(lines, block_start, block_end, stock) {
  block  <- lines[block_start:block_end]
  rows   <- block[grepl(stock, block, fixed = TRUE)]
  header <- strsplit(block[which(grepl("\t", block))[1]], "\t")[[1]]
  vals   <- strsplit(rows, "\t")
  df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, vals), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(df) <- header
  df
}

catch_raw_tab <- parse_table_block(catch_lines, table_marks[1], table_marks[2] - 1, stockcode)

select_df <- catch_raw_tab %>%
  mutate(CatchCategory = recode(CatchCategory,
                                 "BMS landing" = "Landings",
                                 "Logbook Registered Discard" = "Discards"),
         catch = as.numeric(CATON) / 1000) %>%
  select(country = Country, year = Year, category = CatchCategory,
         area = Area, season = Season, catch)

uk_labels <- grep("^UK", unique(select_df$country), value = TRUE)
if (length(uk_labels) > 1) {
  uk_catches <- select_df %>%
    filter(country %in% uk_labels) %>%
    group_by(category, area, season) %>%
    summarise(catch = sum(catch), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(country = "UK", year = currentYear)
  select_df <- select_df %>%
    filter(!country %in% uk_labels) %>%
    bind_rows(uk_catches)
}

write.csv(select_df, "report/catch_area_country.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r fleet-type}
fleet_df <- catch_raw_tab %>%
  mutate(catch_t = as.numeric(CATON) / 1000) %>%
  separate(Fleet, into = c("Gear", "Species"), sep = "_", extra = "drop", fill = "right") %>%
```

## Assessment comparison: this year vs. last year

```{r assess-compare-data}
# Finds the most recent sibling "<year>_<stockcode>_assessment" repo (one level
# up, alongside this one) with an earlier year than the current repo, so this
# section works unmodified in future editions rather than pointing at a fixed year.
find_previous_assessment <- function(stockcode) {
  cur_dir  <- normalizePath(".")
  cur_year <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^([0-9]{4}).*", "\\1", basename(cur_dir))))
  sibs     <- list.dirs(dirname(cur_dir), recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
  cand     <- sibs[grepl(paste0("^[0-9]{4}_", stockcode, "_assessment$"), basename(sibs))]
  cand_yr  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^([0-9]{4}).*", "\\1", basename(cand))))
  keep     <- !is.na(cand_yr) & !is.na(cur_year) & cand_yr < cur_year
  if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
  cand[keep][which.max(cand_yr[keep])]
}

prev_dir  <- find_previous_assessment(stockcode)
prev_base <- if (!is.null(prev_dir)) file.path(prev_dir, "model", "model_base.RData") else NULL
have_prev <- !is.null(prev_base) && file.exists(prev_base)

if (have_prev) {
  prev_env <- new.env()
  load(prev_base, envir = prev_env)
  prevYr_assess <- dims(prev_env$NSHOM)$maxyear

  prev_label <- paste("Assessed through", prevYr_assess)
  cur_label  <- paste("Assessed through", endYr)
  # shared palette for every previous-vs-current comparison figure below
  compare_pal <- setNames(c("#8a94a6", "#1f6feb"), c(prev_label, cur_label))

  prev_summary <- list(
    SSB         = tryCatch(ssb(prev_env$NSHOM.sam),  error = function(e) ssb(prev_env$NSHOM)),
    `Mean F`    = tryCatch(fbar(prev_env$NSHOM.sam), error = function(e) fbar(prev_env$NSHOM)),
    Recruitment = tryCatch(rec(prev_env$NSHOM.sam),  error = function(e) rec(prev_env$NSHOM))
  )
  prev_df <- bind_rows(Map(as_series, prev_summary, names(prev_summary))) %>%
    mutate(assessment = prev_label)

  cur_df <- summary_df %>%
    filter(series != "Catch") %>%
    mutate(assessment = cur_label)

  assess_compare_df <- bind_rows(prev_df, cur_df)
  assess_compare_df$series     <- factor(assess_compare_df$series, levels = c("SSB", "Mean F", "Recruitment"))
  assess_compare_df$assessment <- factor(assess_compare_df$assessment, levels = c(prev_label, cur_label))

  # the previous assessment's terminal year is the one most exposed to revision
  # once another year of data comes in - this is the comparison of interest
  overlap_yr <- prevYr_assess
}
```

```{r assess-compare-plot, results='asis'}
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
```

```{r assess-compare-sr, results='asis'}
if (have_prev) {
  sr_one <- function(stk) {
    ssb_yr <- as.data.frame(ssb(stk))[, c("year", "data")]; names(ssb_yr) <- c("year", "ssb")
    rec_yr <- as.data.frame(rec(stk))[, c("year", "data")]; names(rec_yr) <- c("year", "rec")
    rg <- min(as.numeric(dimnames(stk)$age))

    merge(rec_yr, ssb_yr, by = "year")

    sr_one(prev_env$NSHOM) %>% mutate(assessment = prev_label),
    sr_one(NSHOM)          %>% mutate(assessment = cur_label)

    geom_path(aes(group = assessment), alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = compare_pal) +

    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +

}
```

```{r fit-to-data-setup}
# @residuals carries the observation (log.obs) and the model prediction (log.mdl)
# for every fleet / age / year - the raw material for an observed-vs-fitted plot.
rez      <- NSHOM.sam@residuals
have_fit <- all(c("log.obs", "log.mdl") %in% names(rez))

if (have_fit) {
  fit_wide <- rez %>%
    filter(!is.na(log.obs), !is.na(log.mdl)) %>%
    mutate(age_num  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(age))),
           Observed = exp(log.obs),
           Fitted   = exp(log.mdl))

  # "catch..." fleets are age-structured; everything else (survey / CPUE) is an index
  catch_fleets <- unique(fit_wide$fleet[grepl("catch", fit_wide$fleet, ignore.case = TRUE)])
  catch_wide   <- fit_wide %>% filter(fleet %in% catch_fleets)
  idx_wide     <- fit_wide %>% filter(!fleet %in% catch_fleets)

  fit_pal <- c(Observed = "grey20", Fitted = "#1f6feb")
}
```

```{r obs-var-log-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# obs.var() above is on the natural (variance) scale. SAM actually estimates
# logSdLogObs, whose 95% CI is symmetric in log space, so plot that here to show
# the uncertainty on the scale it was estimated on. Fleet/age-group labels are
# read from the obs.vars control matrix (same idea as the SAM parameter table).
desc_groups <- function(mat) {
  vals <- sort(unique(mat[mat >= 0]))
  setNames(sapply(vals, function(v) {
    idx    <- which(mat == v, arr.ind = TRUE)
    fleets <- unique(rownames(mat)[idx[, 1]])
    ages   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(colnames(mat)[idx[, 2]]))
    arng   <- if (all(is.na(ages))) NA_character_
              else if (length(unique(ages)) == 1) paste0("age ", unique(ages))
              else paste0("ages ", min(ages, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(ages, na.rm = TRUE))
    paste0(paste(fleets, collapse = ", "), ifelse(is.na(arng), "", paste0(": ", arng)))
  }), vals)
}

obsvar_log_one <- function(sam, ctrl, label) {
  lab_vec <- tryCatch(desc_groups(ctrl@obs.vars), error = function(e) NULL)
  sam@params %>%
    filter(name == "logSdLogObs") %>%
    mutate(occurrence = row_number(),
           ages = if (!is.null(lab_vec)) lab_vec[pmin(occurrence, length(lab_vec))]
                  else as.character(occurrence),
           lo = value - 1.96 * std.dev,
           hi = value + 1.96 * std.dev,
           assessment = label)
}

cur_lab <- paste("Assessed through", endYr)
obsvar_log_df <- obsvar_log_one(NSHOM.sam, NSHOM.ctrl, cur_lab)
if (have_prev) {
  obsvar_log_df <- bind_rows(
    obsvar_log_one(prev_env$NSHOM.sam, prev_env$NSHOM.ctrl, prev_label),
    obsvar_log_df
  )
}
obsvar_log_df$assessment <- factor(obsvar_log_df$assessment,
                                   levels = unique(obsvar_log_df$assessment))

p_obsvar_log <- ggplot(obsvar_log_df, aes(ages, value, colour = assessment)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fatten = 2,
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Fleet / ages", y = "logSdLogObs  (log scale, value ± 1.96×SE)",
       colour = NULL,
       title = "Observation variance by fleet and age (log scale)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = if (have_prev) "top" else "none")

if (have_prev) p_obsvar_log <- p_obsvar_log + scale_colour_manual(values = compare_pal)

save_and_show(p_obsvar_log, "obs_variance_log_scale.png")
```

## SAM parameter table

```{r sam-partable}
state_like <- c("logF", "logN", "logCatch", "logCatchByFleet", "logfbar", "logLagR", "logLand",
                "logR", "logssb", "logtsb", "beforeLastLogF", "beforeLastLogN",
                "lastLogF", "lastLogN", "missing")

# Plain-English meaning of each SAM hyperparameter name. These names come from the SAM/TMB
# model structure itself (stable across assessment years), not from this year's data, so this
# lookup doesn't need updating unless NSHOM.ctrl's parameterisation changes.
param_meaning <- c(
  logFpar               = "log survey catchability (q) - see 'Observation variance and survey catchability' above",
  logSdLogFsta           = "log SD of the F-at-age random walk - see 'Process (state) variance' above",
  logSdLogN               = "log SD of the N-at-age (recruitment/survival) random walk - see 'Process (state) variance' above",
  logSdLogObs             = "log SD of observation error - see 'Observation variance and survey catchability' above",
  itrans_rho              = "transformed AR(1) correlation of F-at-age across ages (internal parameterisation)",
  logFScaleMSY            = "log scaling factor linking model F to an external reference-point calculation",
  implicitFunctionDelta   = "internal TMB numerical parameter (Laplace approximation) - not biologically meaningful",
  splinePenalty           = "smoothing penalty for a spline-parameterised term in the model - not biologically meaningful"
)

# which fleet(s)/age(s) each numbered instance of a parameter actually belongs to -
# read directly from NSHOM.ctrl's own group matrices, so this describes whatever
# grouping is actually in use rather than needing manual updates if it ever changes
describe_groups <- function(mat) {
  vals <- sort(unique(mat[mat >= 0]))
  setNames(sapply(vals, function(v) {
    idx <- which(mat == v, arr.ind = TRUE)
    fleets <- unique(rownames(mat)[idx[, 1]])
    ages <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(colnames(mat)[idx[, 2]]))
    arng <- if (all(is.na(ages))) NA_character_
            else if (length(unique(ages)) == 1) paste0("age ", unique(ages))
            else paste0("ages ", min(ages, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(ages, na.rm = TRUE))
    paste0(paste(fleets, collapse = ", "), ifelse(is.na(arng), "", paste0(": ", arng)))
  }), vals)
}

group_labels <- list(
  logFpar      = tryCatch(describe_groups(NSHOM.ctrl@catchabilities), error = function(e) NULL),
  logSdLogFsta = tryCatch(describe_groups(NSHOM.ctrl@f.vars),         error = function(e) NULL),
  logSdLogN    = tryCatch(describe_groups(NSHOM.ctrl@logN.vars),      error = function(e) NULL),
  logSdLogObs  = tryCatch(describe_groups(NSHOM.ctrl@obs.vars),       error = function(e) NULL)
)

par_tab <- NSHOM.sam@params %>%
  filter(!name %in% state_like) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  mutate(occurrence = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    ages = mapply(function(nm, i) {
      g <- group_labels[[nm]]
      if (!is.null(g) && i <= length(g)) g[i] else NA_character_
    }, name, occurrence),
    meaning = ifelse(name %in% names(param_meaning), param_meaning[name], "(no description available)"),
    flag = case_when(
      is.na(std.dev) | !is.finite(std.dev) ~ "check: non-finite SE",
      std.dev > 2                          ~ "check: large SE",
      TRUE                                 ~ "ok"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(name, ages, meaning, value, std.dev, flag)

n_flagged <- sum(par_tab$flag != "ok")

kable(par_tab, digits = 4,
      col.names = c("Parameter", "Fleet/ages", "Meaning", "Estimate (log scale)", "Std. error", "Flag"),
      caption = paste0("SAM parameter table (", stockcode, ", ", currentYear, " assessment) - ",
                        n_flagged, " of ", nrow(par_tab), " parameter(s) flagged"))
```

# Projections

```{r projection-options, results='asis'}
fc_summary_file <- "forecast/options - summary.csv"
fc_multi_file   <- "forecast/multi-options - summary.csv"

if (file.exists(fc_summary_file)) {
  opts <- read.csv(fc_summary_file, check.names = FALSE)
  kable(opts, caption = paste0("Short-term forecast catch options (ImY=", ImY,
                                ", AdY=", AdY, ", CtY=", CtY, ")"), digits = 3)
}
```

```{r projection-sweep-plot, results='asis'}
if (file.exists(fc_multi_file) && file.exists(fc_summary_file)) {
  multi <- read.csv(fc_multi_file, check.names = FALSE)

  fbar_col  <- sprintf("Fbar (%d)", AdY)
  catch_col <- sprintf("Catch (%d)", AdY)
  ssb_col   <- sprintf("SSB (%d)", CtY)

  named_opts <- opts %>%
    select(Rationale, fbar = all_of(fbar_col), catch = all_of(catch_col), ssb = all_of(ssb_col))

  p_yield <- ggplot(multi, aes(.data[[fbar_col]], .data[[catch_col]])) +
    geom_line(colour = "grey50") +
    geom_point(data = named_opts, aes(fbar, catch, colour = Rationale), size = 2.5) +
    labs(x = paste("Fbar", AdY), y = paste("Catch", AdY, "(t)"), colour = NULL,
         title = "Yield vs F") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  p_ssb <- ggplot(multi, aes(.data[[fbar_col]], .data[[ssb_col]])) +
    geom_line(colour = "grey50") +
    geom_point(data = named_opts, aes(fbar, ssb, colour = Rationale), size = 2.5) +
    labs(x = paste("Fbar", AdY), y = paste("SSB", CtY, "(t)"), colour = NULL,
         title = "SSB vs F")

  save_and_show(p_yield + p_ssb, "projection_tradeoff.png", width = 12)
}
```
